Top Analyst Gives a Rare Downgrade to Microsoft Stock (MSFT)

summary_raw: Stifel downgraded MSFT from Buy to Hold on Feb 5 2026, cut PT from $540 to $392. 37 analysts consensus Strong Buy, avg PT ~$566-$571. 31 buy, 2 hold, 0 sell ratings. Wedbush reiterated Outperform Dec 2025. Stifel downgrade appears isolated against overwhelmingly bullish consensus.
